name: Kuruhashi Miyako
source: A girl who got bullied out of school and became a NEET. Miyako spends her days playing games and is quite popular in the online game she constantly plays, rarely takes baths and has become completely unsociable. Because her parents work a lot she spends a lot of time alone.
